title: Command (CI)
text: Unfinished command-CI requirements direct the worker to run the QA case, including when an item-detail response omits method configuration. Merge and terminal checks never advise recording a manual verdict instead of executing the case. A CI attempt is recorded before polling, so merge refuses with its CI run link while it is pending. Completion settles the same run. A retry adopts or supersedes CI and settles abandoned attempts as errors.
